claims.statement: Witherbloom is Strixhaven's black-green College of Essence Studies.
The 2021 guide says Witherbloom mages draw power from opposing forces of life and death.
The 2021 guide describes Witherbloom magic as brewing spells from natural components and living essence to heal, harm, raise, or entreat the dead.
The 2021 guide frames black-aligned Witherbloom mages as exploiting life energy and green-aligned mages as encouraging life energy to blossom and grow.
The 2026 guide lists Witherbloom study areas including alchemy, medicine, biomancy, pathology, toxicology, mortuary science, and necromancy.
Witherbloom placement signals should weight embodied knowledge, life/death exchange, fieldwork, remedies, poisons, ecology, and practical magic.
claims.notes: Placement inference derived from official faction identity and mechanics; not an official Wizards psychological taxonomy.
